chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'southern cross brooch 14k pearl', 'southern cross brooch gold pearls', '14ct southern cross brooch'; also 'southern cross brooch 9ct pearl' for sold. Check Leski, Noble Numismatics, Mossgreen/Theodore Bruce, Davidson Auctions, LiveAuctioneers, Invaluable for sold 'Southern Cross brooch pearl gold'. Note 14K is a US/Asian marking; also search 585 and 14ct. Need a gold-weight-based scrap check once weight known.
viewing_check: Check the back for a stamp (14K, 585, 9ct, 375, 15ct) and any maker mark; photograph it with a loupe. Weigh the brooch if allowed (gold weight sets the floor). Check pins and catch are gold, pearls are real (tooth test) and none loose, and no filled or plated wear.
